items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: No, there was another one, Jane Callender, who was a tennis player, but she was of another hue.

ctx.x: quite a few of them around now. When I first came here (I might have mentioned this before), I was the only Callender in the whole book. No, there was another one, Jane Callender, who was a tennis player, but she was of another hue.
Do you have a Callender Clan Plaid?
